integrity: The infinite \(p\ge11\) statement is proved by an exact \(p\)-adic coefficient argument from the published Newton data. The exceptional prime \(p=7\) is settled by an exact rational Newton recurrence whose displayed value is replayed by the accompanying checker; finite tests are not used as a substitute for the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only indices \(4p\) with prime \(p\ge7\). It does not determine higher dyadic layers or composite odd parts, and a differently phrased or unindexed denominator result could remain undiscovered.
title: A cubic denominator law at the \(4p\) layer of the affine Wang–Sun sum
